abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single configuration of Edisio is allowed.

usb_confirm.title: Discovered Edisio USB dongle
usb_confirm.description: Do you want to configure the Edisio integration with this USB dongle at {serial_port}?

device_confirm.title: Configure Edisio Device {device_id}
device_confirm.description: Button {button} was pressed on Device {device_id}. Select the Button layout of the Device, and optionally name it (e.g. BP Kitchen) and choose its area.

abort.not_implemented: This option is not available yet.
abort.unknown_device: This Device is no longer configured.

error.invalid_radio_id: The Radio ID must be exactly 8 hex digits, e.g. 0670A248.

add_device.title: Add a Device
add_device.description: Enter the Radio ID of the Device without pressing it. Optionally name it (e.g. BP Kitchen) and choose its area.

remove_device.title: Remove a Device
remove_device.description: Pick the Device to forget. Its sensors are deleted; if it is pressed again, a new discovery card is offered.

edit_device_settings.title: Edit Device {radio_id}
edit_device_settings.description: Changing the name replaces any name set on the Home Assistant device page.

data.active_buttons: Button layout (number of active Buttons, 1 to 5)
data.name: Name (empty: default Edisio EBP8-B <Radio ID>)
data.update_entity_ids: Also update entity IDs to match the name

data_description.active_buttons: Button sensors for Button numbers that are no longer in the layout are removed; the others are kept.
data_description.update_entity_ids: Off by default: dashboards and scripts using the old entity IDs keep working. Unique IDs never change.
